args.text: CREATE TABLE Parent (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_Parent PRIMARY KEY, [Name] TEXT(30) NOT NULL, Qty LONG, [Value] DOUBLE)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UX_Parent_Name ON Parent ([Name])
CREATE INDEX IX_Parent_QtyDesc ON Parent (Qty DESC, [Value] ASC)
CREATE INDEX IX_Parent_Ignore ON Parent ([Value]) WITH IGNORE NULL
CREATE INDEX IX_Parent_Required ON Parent (Qty) WITH DISALLOW NULL
CREATE TABLE Child (CID COUNTER CONSTRAINT PK_Child PRIMARY KEY, PID LONG, [Text] TEXT(10))
CREATE TABLE Grand (GID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_Grand PRIMARY KEY, CID LONG CONSTRAINT FK_Grand REFERENCES Child (CID))

CREATE TABLE Typed (K COUNTER CONSTRAINT PK_Typed PRIMARY KEY, TText TEXT(25), TMemo MEMO, TByte BYTE, TInt SHORT, TLong LONG, TSingle SINGLE, TDouble DOUBLE, TCur CURRENCY, TDate DATETIME, TBool YESNO, TOle LONGBINARY, TGuid GUID)
INSERT INTO Typed (TText, TMemo, TByte, TInt, TLong, TSingle, TDouble, TCur, TDate, TBool) VALUES ('t', 'm', 7, -3, 70000, 1.5, 2.25, 3.75, #01/02/2026#, True)
SELECT ID, [Name] FROM Parent ORDER BY ID;
PARAMETERS pId Long, pName Text (20); SELECT ID, [Name] FROM Parent WHERE ID = pId OR [Name] = pName;
PARAMETERS pDelta Long; UPDATE Parent SET Qty = Qty + pDelta;
INSERT INTO Grand (GID) SELECT CID FROM Child WHERE CID < 0;
SELECT ID, [Name] INTO Made FROM Parent;
TRANSFORM Sum(Qty) AS SumQty SELECT [Name] FROM Parent GROUP BY [Name] PIVOT ID;
SELECT ID FROM Parent UNION SELECT PID FROM Child;
